# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop is an unofficial, open-source, lightweight cross-platform Wails desktop shell for the official DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

Canonical website: https://zsyu9779.github.io/dsh-desktop/
Source code: https://github.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop
Latest release: https://github.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop/releases/latest
Official upstream: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

## Verified project facts

- Current desktop version: 0.1.13, published 2026-09-16.
- Pinned upstream package: @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1.
- Platforms: macOS universal, Windows amd64, Linux amd64.
- Release packages are approximately 4–11 MB; exact v0.1.13 sizes are listed on GitHub Releases after the automated build completes.
- Runtime requirement: Node.js 22.19+ on the 22.x line, or Node.js 24.2+ on the 24.x line, with npm.
- Desktop stack: Go and Wails, using the operating system WebView.
- The project does not fork or reimplement the upstream DSH Web UI.
- The shell manages environment checks, startup, local port selection, readiness, logs and process cleanup.
- Version 0.1.13 keeps the pinned upstream DSH runtime at 0.1.5-rc.1, requires Node.js 24.2+ on the 24.x line, and ships preinstalled plugins (open-editor, diff-review, account-login, agent-preset-compat, webview-compat) into the DSH profile at launch. webview-compat defines the Iterator global older WebKit lacks, so the right sidebar's document preview works on macOS before 15.4 again; the file-changes and subagent-max plugins an earlier release installed are removed on upgrade.
- The project is not affiliated with DeepSeek AI.
- macOS packages are signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized; Windows executables are not code-signed.
- License: MIT.
